name: cert-expiry
description: Inventory's TLS certificate expires at 14:00; checkout's stock checks fail the TLS handshake. Inventory's own metrics stay healthy because the calls never reach it.

changes.detail: TLS certificate for inventory.shopco.internal reached notAfter (expired); no renewal recorded

log_effects.message: stock check failed for order {id}: TLS handshake with inventory.shopco.internal failed: x509: certificate has expired
inventory unavailable, blocking order {id} (no stock confirmation)

ground_truth.root_cause: Inventory's TLS certificate expired at 14:00, so checkout's calls to inventory failed the TLS handshake.
ground_truth.expected_action: Renew the inventory TLS certificate and reload inventory
